-- 双方向で作成し、statusをacceptedに設定
INSERT INTO friendships (userId, friendId, status, createdAt, updatedAt) VALUES
(1, 3, 'accepted', NOW(), NOW()),
(3, 1, 'accepted', NOW(), NOW()),
